main chat, a user-typed prompt delivered as a PLAIN STRING content instead of an array of blocks. 2.1.277 sent every typed prompt as blocks and only harness side calls as plain strings; 2.1.278 sends typed prompts this way too, so content shape no longer identifies the writer. `expect` is the classification WITHOUT a hook stream, which is what test/support/fixtures.ts loads: with no UserPromptSubmit to match, the request stays side/unclassified and says why. Replayed together with ultracode.hooks.jsonl (whose UserPromptSubmit prompt is exactly this text) the same bytes classify as turn=new; test/unit/wire-plain-string.test.ts asserts both directions.

gaps: UNCAPTURED side_kind notification (AFK session recap): observed only as a side_fingerprint head in the maintainer's 2.1.278 route-mode log of 2026-09-19 (2 calls; last content a 253-character plain string; messages 78 and 242). The marker in src/wire/markers.ts is that redacted 80-code-point head; no body was captured, so no fixture asserts it. Synthetic cases in test/unit/wire.test.ts.

UNCAPTURED side_kind tool_result_text (tool results plus harness text in the last user message): same log, 2 calls, one main chat and one subagent, both with 9,417 characters of text beside the results. Recognised by shape, not by a marker, so no text was needed to implement it; no body was captured, so no fixture asserts it. Synthetic cases in test/unit/wire.test.ts.

UNCAPTURED interjection (a message typed mid-tool-loop, classified as a continuation): same log, 2 calls whose fingerprint head was dropped as typed_prompt. Recognising one needs the session's UserPromptSubmit prompts, so a request fixture alone cannot carry the case; a future capture must pair the request with its hooks.jsonl.

DERIVED, not captured: ultracode.main-new-turn-plain-string.request.json. STILL OPEN. A capture on 2026-09-19 (same 2.1.278 minor) did NOT reproduce a plain string as the NEWEST message: all four of its typed prompts arrived as block arrays. It did prove that a prompt's identical text is re-encoded as a plain string once it sits in history (same sha256 prefix 907dbed69a, 119 code points). The capture's main requests carry set-identical betas to the regression session, so the betas are NOT the trigger; the trigger is unknown. Leading lead: the plain-string residuals occur only in sessions where REFLEX_DELEGATE=1 injected additionalContext into UserPromptSubmit, which scripts/spike/capture.mjs (answers every hook 204) cannot do. Replacing this fixture needs a capture that carries the hint through. See docs/wire-format.md 4.3.
